data.one_liner: A customizable horizontal date timeline picker widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontal timeline interface for selecting dates with various customization options for appearance, selection modes, and behavior. Supports custom item builders, localized formatting, and date disable strategies.
use_when: You need a horizontal date picker or calendar timeline view in your app.
You want to customize day appearances, selection behavior, and headers.
You require localization support for different date formats.
avoid_when: You need a full traditional monthly grid calendar view instead of a horizontal timeline.
You are looking for a state management or data storage solution.
strengths: Highly customizable day items and layout structure.
Comprehensive disable strategies for restricting date selections.
Built-in support for multiple locales and selection modes.
weaknesses: Limited to horizontal timeline views rather than grid-based calendars.
Legacy API components exist alongside the newer picker widget.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or permissions required. Simply add the dependency and import the package.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a standard grid-based calendar date picker instead of a horizontal timeline.

data.minimal_example:
EasyDateTimeLinePicker(
  focusedDate: DateTime.now(),
  firstDate: DateTime(2024, 3, 18),
  lastDate: DateTime(2030, 3, 18),
  onDateChange: (date) {},
)
